subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Forecast Horizon
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Forecast Horizon.

hook.text: Predicting tomorrow's demand is easy. Predicting next year's is a guess. The horizon changes everything.

buildup.text: Forecast horizons range from short-term (days/weeks) to medium (months) to long-term (years).

discovery.text: Short-term drives daily operations. Medium-term guides procurement. Long-term shapes capacity investments.

twist.text: Accuracy drops sharply as the horizon extends. A 90% accurate weekly forecast may be 60% accurate annually.

climax.text: Match the forecast method to the horizon. Statistical models for short-term; scenarios for long-term.

punchline.text: The further you look, the fuzzier it gets. Plan accordingly.

quiz.question: What happens to forecast accuracy as the horizon extends?
